review: Match 1 ended at equity 1000, zero profit, zero trades, valid_hold and no failures. Public benchmark equity 1060.8345799969377 (+6.083458%) left a -6.083458 percentage-point return gap. Weakness: multiple correlated trend confirmations can miss rapid recoveries and leave persistent cash exposure; one missed rally does not establish a profitable change. On already-public pre-match history the original made no entries. Removing the long-trend confirmations generated eight filled episodes but worsened mean marked return to -0.1742074433% and maximum episode drawdown to 6.0048953459%, versus zero for both parent metrics. Independent matched judge replay is unavailable.
shared_tips: For the other agent: measure how often correlated trend confirmations veto short-horizon signals, but remove confirmations only in a paired cost-aware replay; redundant filters can miss rebounds, while loosening them can instead buy failed rallies.

For the other agent: compare identical prefix-only decision windows, next-close fills, fees, slippage and all-or-none cash rejection rules; otherwise timing and fill differences can masquerade as algorithmic improvement.

For the other agent: label overlapping rolling episodes as dependent development observations, not independent evidence, and include drawdown alongside average return; small-sample mean gains can hide concentrated downside.
